**Finding: Compliant** — no redline needed.

The agreement imposes no liquidated damages, penalties, forfeitures, or minimum/early-termination fees on Sparkling (our side):

- **§ 11 (Fees)** — bare obligation to pay per the Fee Schedule; no late-payment interest or penalty mechanic.
- **§ 17(b) (Termination)** — we may terminate for convenience on 90 days' notice with **no** termination fee, accelerated fees, or payment of remaining contract value.
- **§ 17 (default)** — on Garman's default, the licence converts to perpetual and fee-free and Garman must refund prepaid fees for services not rendered (i.e., LD-type value runs in our favour, which the playbook treats as acceptable).
- **§§ 3, 9, 19** — use restrictions, co-operation, and non-solicitation carry no monetary penalties.
- **§ 15** — mutual remedy is limited to direct damages, with consequential loss excluded.

One note for negotiation, not a rule breach: § 10 (Maintenance and Support) contains no service credit regime, so we have no pre-agreed remedy for support failures. That falls outside this rule (which only bites where the customer pays), but may be worth raising under the service levels rule.
